description: Updates only the fields present in `changes` on an owned address and returns the result; omitted fields stay unchanged. Coordinates are immutable after create. Use it to edit label, instructions, floor and similar fields; use create_address for a new pin; use delete_address only to remove an address permanently. Fails if the code is not owned by the connected account.

changes.description: Partial address fields to update. Omit keys you do not want to change. Example: {"instructions":"الباب الأصفر","floor":5}

buildingName.description: Building name if provided. Example: برج الملقا

category.description: Optional category tag. Example: home, work, shop

city.description: City only if the user provided it. Example: الرياض

country.description: Country name or ISO-ish label if provided. Example: السعودية or SA

floor.description: Floor / level of the unit. Example: 5 or G

oneOf.description: Floor label when not a plain number. Example: G or 3B

houseNumber.description: House / unit number if provided. Example: 12

instructions.description: Delivery notes for the courier (door color, buzzer, landmark). Example: الباب الأصفر، دق الجرس

label.description: Short friendly label for the address. Example: البيت or المكتب

neighborhood.description: Neighborhood / district if provided. Example: حي الملقا

ownerName.description: Display name for the address owner only if the user provided one. Example: أحمد

phone.description: Contact phone in international or local form if provided. Example: +9665xxxxxxx

pin.description: Optional 4-digit privacy PIN that couriers must enter to view details. Example: 4821

pinEnabled.description: When true, details stay locked until the correct 4-digit PIN is entered. Example: true

postalCode.description: Postal / ZIP code if provided. Example: 13521

saudiNationalCode.description: Optional Saudi national short code (AAAA####) when country is SA. Pass empty string to clear. Example: RADC2959

street.description: Street name if the user provided it. Example: شارع التحلية

code.description: Anwani permanent 9-digit address code (digits 1–9 only). Example: 365131449

name: patch_address
